answer: What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution before the ledger credits work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. The nectar is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the echo.
